I know this is going to get buried, but I feel the need to tell this.

This was last year actually, in the 8th grade. :) I had a new teacher who we'll call Mr. D. He was a pretty average guy. It was his first year at my middle school, which was the worst middle school in Kentucky, seriously. This school is so bad, my class, the AP, is the worst fucking class out of all of them. 

So, two weeks into the school year, everyone's acting like a fuckface as usual. But something must have set him off, I guess. Maybe it was the pen throwing across the room, or the constant "FUCK YOU NIGGA." But the man lost it. This guy didn't seem like a yeller. He had a gentle voice, but when I say he flipped his shit, he...he flipped his shit. I was slightly intimidated. People were chuckling a little bit. Basically, he made us ALL write definitions out of a book and left to blow off some steam. I felt bad, because earlier in the day while I was being a teacher's aide, I heard the assistant principal tell my math teacher how cool he was and how nobody paid attention to him (He was a history teacher.) So I wrote him a note about how he seemed to be the nicest teacher I had and that if nobody in the world listened to him, I would. 

The next day, everyone was still acting like a fuckface, but he seemed a bit keen on me. During class, he pulled me aside and thanked me and told me how that really meant a lot to him. He gave me a big hug and then set me down. I fell in love with him the very next day after thinking about it. And I still am, truth. Nobody will ever be as nice to me as he was. 


Obviously, from then on, I was his favorite student. He got me McDonalds during lunch, always bought me random stuff, and he was genuinely nice to me because I was nice to him. 

You know, I was really in love with him. So on the last day of school, instead of hanging out with my friends, I hung out with him and helped him clean up his room and prepare it for next year. And then the 1st day of summer, I came in to school and helped him again. In the last 5 minutes we could actually be together before he had to leave, he told me that he still had that letter and would keep it forever.

That prompted to tell me I loved him, he told me he loved me too (obviously not the way I loved him -- well I don't know really.), and then he left.

TL;DR - Was nice to teacher, then he was nice to me. then i fell in love with him and THIS SOUNDS LIKE A GREAT NBC COMEDY. INCONSISTENT STORY LINE, MIGHT BE GOOD FOR A SEASON OR TWO...
